# Normalization Bounds Calibration

**Generated by:** `python -m src.scoring.calibrate_bounds`  
**Scope:** latest observation per place at or before 2026  
**Quantiles:** 0.05 / 0.95  

Bounds are fixed anchors: they do not change when a place improves, so scores stay comparable across years. Values outside the bounds are clipped before normalization.

## Review notes

Configured bounds already match the calibrated percentiles.

## Reproduce

```bash
python -m src.scoring.calibrate_bounds --year 2026 --lower-quantile 0.05 --upper-quantile 0.95
python -m src.scoring.run_scoring
python -m src.models.run_ml
python -m src.analysis.run_eda
python -m src.export_frontend_data
```
